title: Herbal Medicine & Nutraceuticals
note: A small herbal product workshop in Africa can start with basic extraction and formulation equipment and scale into a licensed nutraceutical brand.

startup.item: Dried medicinal herbs and raw materials (bulk)
Empty capsules, bottles, tincture droppers, and labels
Digital scale, pH meter, and basic lab glassware
Salve and cream-making supplies (beeswax, oils, shea butter)
Business registration and product testing fees
